notes.title: Demo Update 5.4.0 - Combat start
notes.content:
Hey all,

Today's update brings a new starting option to the demo, which is Combat. 
It includes a brand new starter ship as well, the Margil, adds its own skill tree and a different path to finish the demo. 

Changes:
[list]
[*] Combat start as an option for New Game
[*] Margil is now available as a starter ship
[*] Skill tree for combat
[*] New missions
[*] New path to finish the demo
[*] Fullscreen toggle added in menu's
[*] Added buyback to shops for when you accidentally sell something important
[*] Stack manipulation added so you can organize your inventory more easily
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] The Gatling gun performance has been improved
[*] Improved transparency, some assets would still allow you to see through or click through the game
[*] Chunks falling of ships would sometimes move in a funny way, no more, we don't like funny
[*] The Galaxy map would break when you still had completed missions open
[*] Material storage now correctly works when selecting the "Material Storage Boost" skill
[/list]

And some smaller tweaks.

Enjoy the demo and tell us what you think. And let us know if you like the new combat start.

Cheers,

Bad Roost Games

notes.title: Demo update 0.5.3 encore
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just pushed a hotfix for our recent update.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Transparency option added that is enabled by default. It works well with the Steam overlay. The old transparency option is available as Performant.
[*] Added an option to move the transparent window, so its now possible to stick it to the top of your window if you like. :)
[*] Starting credits increased
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for camera losing track of spaceship when the game loses focus
[*] Fix for docking after combat, the spaceship sometimes kept moving
[*] Fix for teleporting of items to your cargo if they were completed in another spacestation
[*] Improved NPC behavior
[/list]
And a bunch of small tweaks.

Enjoy the demo and tell us what you think.

Cheers,

Bad Roost Games

notes.title: Demo update 0.5.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just pushed a small update to our demo version of the game.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added basic Steam Deck support
[*] Added fullscreen experimental option. For those that were wishing to play this game fullscreen on their second monitor, now you can!
[*] Added one new combat ship available for purchase
[*] Added two new spaceships for ambient spaceship captains
[*] Added reactor and energy management to equipment
[*] Improved combat look and feel, reduced combat difficulty
[*] Small UI look and feel improvements
[*] Added autocannon sound
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for spaceship getting stuck in front of jumpgates
[*] Fix for loading the savegame after finishing the demo
[*] Better behavior for the steamoverlay in combination with transparency
[/list]
And various other small improvements.

Have fun playing the demo and let us know what you think.

Cheers,

Bad Roost Games
